description: Contract for original evidence-backed research shards. Each lane owns one JSON file. Required keys are listed below; additional descriptive fields are permitted.

lane.recordIdRule: Each source/browser/feature/issue id starts with the owning lane id and a hyphen; IDs are globally unique.

source.dateRule: retrievedAt is a real YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601 timestamp; publishedAt is a real date/timestamp or null. Timestamps require Z or an explicit +/-HH:mm or +/-HHmm offset; timezone-less timestamps are invalid. When both values are timestamps, publication must not follow retrieval as an absolute instant, retaining all fractional-second digits. If either value is date-only, compare the written YYYY-MM-DD values without assuming midnight or the host timezone. Never use fabricated generic dates from extraction metadata.

browser.engineRule: String; qualify OS/edition differences and unknowns. platforms is a nonempty array of strings.

feature.browserIdRule: References a browser in the same lane. Chrome baseline features belong to R01.

submission.urlRule: null unless a real existing-upstream URL or verified new submission receipt exists. An upstream-report kind, upstream-open/upstream-closed status, or upstream-reported evidence makes a record ineligible to count as a new project submission, including existing feature requests. Genuine project-origin proposals remain eligible with verified receipts; retaining the new receipt's upstream URL/status metadata alone does not make it an existing report.

issue.reproductionRule: local-reproduced requires nonempty testedVersions and evidence references for an actual test; otherwise testedVersions must be empty. Source inspection is source-only, never a browser reproduction.

runtime.unrunSourceFollowupsRule: Entries in unrunSourceFollowups accept only unrun. Counter changes do not establish execution. Executed nativeChecks require expected/observed results and concrete local runtime evidence.

common.sourceIdsRule: Nonempty array of IDs referring to sources in the same lane.
common.limitationsRule: Array of strings. Be explicit about documentary versus hands-on coverage.
common.emptyCollections: Use empty arrays for record types outside a lane's assignment.
common.extraFields: Useful fields such as sourceRevision, component, recommendationCandidates, quotations and queryLog are allowed. Source-backed facts in them retain citation IDs.
